text:
Predicates:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ::: x is a summer Olympic games.
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastGames(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x took place in location y.
UnitedStates(x) ::: x is the United States.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in event y.
Tokyo(y) ::: y is Tokyo.
Premises:
SummerOlympicGames(x) ∧ SportingEvent(x) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastGames(x) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
Location(x, Tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
UnitedStates(y) ∧ WonMostMedals(y, x) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
¬Location(x, Tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games were not in Tokyo.
